subject: Request: Senior approval for 28% Hosted usage concession — DeepCare
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Senior approval for 28% Hosted usage concession — DeepCare

Team — looping you in for a quick exec sign-off request. DeepCare (prospect -> strategic target in cardiology analytics) is pushing hard for a 12‑month committed usage agreement but asking for a 28% reduction to our published Hosted API usage rates. Quick facts:

- Proposed term: 12 months, commit to $1.8M billed monthly (forecasted usage).
- Customer ask: 28% off list for the duration, with a 60-day ramp credit to cover onboarding.
- Upside: Customer has a 60% probability to expand into Dedicated in Q4 and is integrated with a health system that could drive regional referrals.
- Risk: Heavy short‑term utilization pattern; forecast attached (usage-forecast.xlsx).

Why I recommend exception: competitive threat from competitor X (who quoted a deep pilot), strategic reference value for payer customers, and higher LTV if we secure Dedicated later. Unit economics attached (unit-econ-summary.csv).

Ask: Senior approval for a one-time exception to allow 28% hosted usage concession for 12 months with the following guardrails:
- 12-month commitment with monthly true‑ups;
- 28% off list capped to $500k total discount over the term;
- No changes to data retention or security terms; any legal redlines limited to attachments/comments in DeepCare_MSA_redlines.pdf;
- DocuSign/HubSpot link will be used for final signature.

I've attached the procurement email (procurement@deepcarehealth.com) and the proposed MSA with redlines. Need a clear green / amber / red from finance and sales leadership by 2/19 EOD to not lose momentum.

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for 28% Hosted usage concession — DeepCare

Markus / all —
Thanks for the summary. A few quick clarifying questions before I take to Mina for final sign-off:

1) Is the $1.8M committed ARR billed as usage (variable) or as a minimum monthly spend?
2) What does the predicted cadence look like (month 1 vs month 6)? I want to ensure we're not front-loading most of the consumption and carrying most of the cost.
3) Is legal okay with the redlines you noted? Any material security asks?

If finance can live at 28% with a discount cap and a predefined rollback at renewal, I'm supportive of presenting this to Mina as a strategic concession. Monica — can you confirm CS readiness for onboarding and any delivery risk?

-ben
Ben Carter
VP Sales Operations
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T13:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for 28% Hosted usage concession — DeepCare

Answers inline: 
1) Contract structure: 12-month committed usage agreement with a minimum monthly spend (we'll invoice monthly; true-ups if they exceed committed usage). They want predictable unit rates per 1M tokens but with the 28% off list applied to our hosted per-token pricing.
2) Cadence: month 1 ~8% of commit, month 3 ~18%, month 6 ~45%, month 9+ steady. I've attached detailed forecast. The ramp credit request is a 60‑day startup credit (we suggested a $75k onboarding credit).
3) Legal: legal has reviewed the redlines; only two small MSAs edits requested around indemnity caps and a clarification on audit cadence — nothing security blocking. Security asked for SOC2 Type II evidence (we can provide), but no additional controls beyond our standard.

Unit economics: even at a 28% concession, projected net margin after GPU and infra is ~32% across the 12 months, assuming the ramp behaves to forecast. Finance comment (Rishi) below with delta analysis.

Recommendation: Approve 28% concession with the following must-haves:
- Discount cap: $500k of total discount funded against commission pool (so reps don't over-index compensation).
- Clear renewal trigger: reprice to list at renewal unless usage > 150% of commit.
- Security evidence delivered prior to go-live.

If Ben/Mina OK with the cap, I think this is the right strategic push — high chance to convert to Dedicated and a reference in the cardiology payer network.

-Markus
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-19T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for 28% Hosted usage concession — DeepCare

Markus — reviewed the numbers. Short summary from finance:

- If approved as structured (28% off, discount cap $500k), expected ARR recognized in year 1 is $1.3M net after discount (we'll amortize onboarding credit).
- Gross margin pressure is manageable (projected gross margin ~32%), but we must avoid open-ended stacking of similar concessions in the same vertical.
- Condition: finance will accept 28% only if contract includes a mid-term KPI clause (quarterly usage review) and a minimum penalty/rollback if usage falls below 60% of forecast in two consecutive months.

I can support up to 28% as a one-off strategic concession with the discount cap and the KPI guardrails. Final sign-off needs senior exec approval (Mina) for anything >20% per policy.

-Rishi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Sales recommends approval given the strategic reference potential and pipeline expansion into Dedicated.

Can you please confirm one of the following: APPROVE (with guardrails outlined), APPROVE CONDITIONAL (specify changes), or DECLINE? We need a response by EOD tomorrow to maintain momentum.

Thanks —
Ben
